text.p: Texas Equipment Corp said Monday it has settled litigation related to its acquisition of Texas Equipment Co Inc and the company's former principals, who are currently principals of its wholly owned subsidiary, Marinex Multimedia Corp.
As part of the settlement, the company said it will close Marinex Multimedia.
In addition, the former principals of Marinex will cease affiliation with Texas Equipment Corp, although they will be paid salaries for all of 1997, the company said.
As part of the settlement, the principals will return 250,000 shares of the company's common stock and will relinquish all options or warrants to acquire additional stock, Texas Equipment Corp said.
The company said it also waived any right to the return of stock now owned by former owners of Texas Equipment Co.
Jonathan Braun, a Marinex principal, is to resign as a director of Texas Equipment Corp, the company said.
Texas Equipment Corp owns several John Deere dealerships.
